│ He climbed the hundred and twelve steps that evening as he always did, one  │
│ hand on the cold iron rail. The wind came hard off the water, carrying salt │
│ and the smell of kelp rotting on the rocks below. At the top, he polished   │
│ the lens. He did not need to. The crew had cleaned it on their survey       │
│ visit, and the brass fittings gleamed. But his hands wanted the work, and   │
│ so he gave it to them.                                                      │
